sections.chapter_title: Universal serial bus full-speed host/device interface (USB)
sections.section_title: Programming considerations for Device and Host modes
sections.text_helper: Section 29.5 "Programming considerations for Device and Host modes" in chapter 29 (Universal serial bus full-speed host/device interface (USB)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 959.
sections.section_content:
In the following sections, the expected interactions between the USB peripheral and the
application program are described, in order to ease application software development.
